fellowship.projectTitle: Using Machine Learning for Improved Imaging Interpretation of Alzheimer's Disease
fellowship.projectAbstract: This project aims to leverage advanced deep learning techniques to analyze MR (Magnetic Resonance) images for the detection and classification of Alzheimer’s disease (AD). The work will focus on the development and implementation of a Deep Neural Network (DNN) model capable of identifying structural brain changes associated with different stages of AD. Using a large dataset of MRI images, the DNN will be trained to distinguish between healthy subjects, early-stage, and advanced-stage AD patients. The research will involve pre-processing MRI data, optimizing the architecture of the DNN for image analysis, and fine-tuning hyperparameters to achieve high accuracy and efficiency. Additionally, model performance will be evaluated using metrics such as precision, recall, and F1- score, and visualizations will be created to interpret the model’s decisionmaking process.
